description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Sales/LoadProgress. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Reads the auto-ordering progress of one exact order line. ownerAgent: orders-autoordering. Domain: orders. Entity: order_line. Operation: get_progress. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use it to see the auto-ordering states of an existing order line, for example to explain why an automatic purchase failed. Input: [FromBody] rq: LoadProgressRequest. Main fields: Id: int. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns states (id, date, status, error, errorMessage), lastStatus, lastStatusUpdate and lastAccountAlias. errorMessage is null for most errors. It is returned for CandBeMarkedAsDisparched errors and for OutOfStock errors whose text starts with No eligible new offer. That text means auto-ordering refused the order because the supplier has no offer in new condition, so nothing was bought; the text after Refused conditions:  lists the conditions it found. Search terms: sales loadprogress. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
